recipe.title: Blackberry, Chia & Skyr Pots
recipe.description: Thick, creamy skyr pots layered with juicy blackberries and chia seeds, lightly sweetened with honey for a simple portable snack with fresh fruit acidity and a gently set texture.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 300 g; retail pot size may vary.
ingredients.notes: Use a thick plain skyr without added sugar.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 180 g; retail punnet size may vary.
ingredients.preparation: Inspect, rinse gently if required and dry thoroughly.
ingredients.notes: Choose ripe berries without leaking juice or mould.
The chia seeds absorb moisture from the skyr and fruit, helping the pots remain thick during transport.
Use 1 tsp per serving to balance the natural tartness of the berries and skyr.

equipment.notes: Used to combine the skyr and chia seeds.
Used to portion the skyr, blackberries and chia seeds.
Use leak-resistant containers suitable for refrigerated transport.

mise_en_place.instruction: Inspect the blackberries and discard any damaged or mouldy fruit. Rinse gently only if required, then dry thoroughly so excess water does not loosen the finished pots.
mise_en_place.endpoint: The blackberries are clean, intact and dry on the surface.

mise_en_place.instruction: Measure 300 g skyr, 20 g chia seeds and 2 tsp runny honey.
mise_en_place.endpoint: All measured ingredients are ready for rapid assembly.

procedure.title: Mix the chia skyr
procedure.instruction: Combine the 300 g skyr, 20 g chia seeds and 2 tsp runny honey. Stir thoroughly for approximately 30-45 seconds, scraping around the bowl so the chia seeds are evenly dispersed rather than collecting in clumps.
procedure.endpoint: The mixture is smooth and evenly speckled with chia seeds, with no dry clumps remaining.

corrective_actions.condition: The chia seeds form dense clumps.
corrective_actions.action: Press the clumps against the side of the bowl with the spoon and continue mixing until the seeds are evenly distributed.

procedure.title: Layer the pots
procedure.instruction: Divide approximately half of the chia-skyr mixture between the two pots. Divide approximately half of the blackberries over that layer. Add the remaining chia-skyr mixture, then finish with the remaining blackberries. Handle the berries gently so most remain intact rather than releasing excessive juice.
procedure.endpoint: Each pot contains an even portion of skyr mixture and approximately 90 g blackberries, with visible layers and minimal free fruit juice.

corrective_actions.condition: The blackberries are exceptionally ripe and release substantial juice during assembly.
corrective_actions.action: Place the juiciest berries on the top layer rather than underneath the skyr so the base remains thick.

procedure.title: Allow the chia to hydrate
procedure.instruction: Seal the pots and refrigerate for at least 10 minutes before eating or transporting. They may instead be prepared the evening before.
procedure.endpoint: The chia-skyr mixture has thickened slightly and holds its shape around the berries without becoming gelatinous.

corrective_actions.condition: The mixture appears looser than expected after 10 minutes.
corrective_actions.action: Refrigerate for another 10 minutes; do not add additional chia seeds because the mixture will continue thickening during storage.

plating.instruction: Serve the pots chilled. Stir lightly while eating so some blackberries break into the creamy chia-skyr mixture while others remain intact for contrasting bursts of fruit.

storage.storage_instructions: Keep sealed and refrigerated and use within 2 days. For taking to work or on a car journey, transport the pots in an insulated bag with an ice pack and refrigerate on arrival where possible. Keep chilled until shortly before eating.

either_retailer: Fresh blackberries — use 180 g; retail punnet size may vary.

restaurant_quality_features: Fresh blackberries provide sharp, juicy contrast against thick creamy skyr.
Chia seeds create a gently thickened texture without requiring cooking.
A restrained amount of honey balances the fruit and dairy acidity without making the snack overly sweet.
Layered assembly preserves visible fruit pieces and contrasting textures.
nutrition_notes: Morning snacks have no minimum protein requirement.
Skyr nevertheless provides substantial protein and calcium.
Blackberries and chia seeds provide a high-fibre combination.
Chia seeds contribute unsaturated fats including alpha-linolenic acid.
Nutrition values are estimates and will vary slightly with the exact skyr product and blackberry sweetness.
critical_success_factors: Dry the blackberries thoroughly before assembly.
Distribute the chia seeds evenly through the skyr so they hydrate consistently.
Allow at least 10 minutes of refrigerated hydration before eating.
Avoid crushing all of the blackberries during assembly.
Maintain refrigeration during storage and transport.
